name: Glencore plc
content: Glencore plc is one of the world's largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Founded in the 1970s as a trading company, it has grown to become a major producer and marketer of commodities - employing 140,000 people around the world. Glencore's operations comprise around 150 mining and metallurgical sites and oil production assets. The company's strategy is to be active at every stage of the commodity supply chain, from sourcing and processing to storage and transport, serving industrial consumers in sectors such as automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing, and oil refining.

tabs.content:
Officers

Gary Nagle(Date: 2021 July)

Chief Executive Officer

Gary Nagle joined Glencore in 2000 and was appointed CEO in July 2021. He has held various senior roles across the group, including Global Head of Ferroalloys and CEO of Glencore Agriculture. He holds commerce and accounting degrees from the University of the Witwatersrand and is a Chartered Accountant (South Africa).

Steven Kalmin(Date: 2005 June)

Chief Financial Officer

Steven Kalmin joined Glencore in 1999 and was appointed CFO in 2005. He oversaw the company's IPO in 2011. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of New South Wales and is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants (Australia).

Directors

Kalidas Madhavpeddi(Date: 2021 July)

Chairman

Kalidas Madhavpeddi was appointed Chairman in July 2021. He has over 40 years of experience in the international mining industry, including as CEO of China Molybdenum International. He holds degrees from the Indian Institute of Technology and the University of Iowa.

Gary Nagle(Date: 2021 July)

Executive Director

Chief Executive Officer of Glencore plc.

Martin Gilbert(Date: 2017 March)

Senior Independent Director

Co-founder of Aberdeen Asset Management. He is Chairman of Revolut and AssetCo plc.

Cynthia Carroll(Date: 2021 February)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Former CEO of Anglo American plc and former President and CEO of Alcan Primary Metals.

Gill Marcus(Date: 2018 January)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Former Governor of the South African Reserve Bank and former Non-Executive Director of Gold Fields Ltd.

David Miller(Date: 2023 January)

Non-Executive Director

Portfolio Manager at Elliott Investment Management L.P. with extensive experience in the mining sector.

Liz Hewitt(Date: 2022 September)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Former Group Director of Corporate Affairs at Smith & Nephew plc and former Non-Executive Director of Melrose Industries plc.
